name: Crude Wooden Shield
description: A primitive, splintered wooden shield lashed together with battered copper bands.

name: Oak Wooden Shield
description: A sturdy oak shield ringed by polished bronze edging.

name: Ash Wooden Shield
description: A pale ashwood shield with brushed rusty iron bands.

name: Cedar Wooden Shield
description: A fragrant cedar shield etched with silver leaves around a glowing sigil at its heart.

name: Ebony Wooden Shield
description: A gleaming black ebony shield trimmed with gold celestial marks that shine in the dark.

name: Worldroot Wooden Shield
description: An ancient, knotty shield of mythical worldroot, alive with pulsing lines of star metal within the wood.

name: Beginner's Reinforced Shield
description: A basic oval shield of solid planks, strengthened with rough copper bands.

name: Riveted Reinforced Shield
description: A robust wooden shield with orderly bronze rivets reinforcing its face.

name: Bossed Reinforced Shield
description: A circular shield with a heavy central iron boss.

name: Plated Reinforced Shield
description: A large shield faced with mirror-like hardened plating that glows with protective magic.

name: Barred Reinforced Shield
description: A broad, rectangular shield braced with golden bars and glowing with warding magic.

name: Battleforged Reinforced Shield
description: A heavy champion's shield of war-forged design, surging with glowing star metal.

name: Rusty Metal Shield
description: A round, battered shield of patchwork copper plates, dented and rusted from long neglect.

name: Steelbound Shield
description: A heavy, reinforced shield with a broad bronze face and a sturdy rim.

name: Warforged Iron Shield
description: A militaristic, rectangular shield with a heavy iron core and studded face.

name: Ironheart Shield
description: A sturdy, heart-shaped shield etched with silver glyphs that glow with protective magic.

name: Ironbound Shield
description: A solid, banded shield inlaid with flowing gold and gilded decorations.

name: Deathless Iron Shield
description: A sinister shield with skeletal motifs, pulsing with the eerie power of star metal.

name: Dusk Ebony Shield
description: A broad, oblong shield of dusky ebony set with a copper boss.

name: Twilight Ebony Shield
description: A gently curved ebony shield banded in warm bronze.

name: Shadow Ebony Shield
description: A pointed ebony shield clad in midnight iron, nearly invisible in low light.

name: Midnight Ebony Shield
description: A strong oval shield of pure midnight ebony, radiant with elegant silver.

name: Umbral Ebony Shield
description: A sinister, spiked ebony shield marked with sunburst gold.

name: Eclipsed Ebony Shield

description: A narrow, leaf-shaped shield of mantis chitin patterned in bronze.

name: Scorpion Chitin Shield
description: A round shield of black, jointed scorpion chitin set in an iron frame.

name: Spider Chitin Shield
description: A light, oval shield of black spider chitin, enchanted with sprawling silver webs.

name: Wyrm Chitin Shield
description: An imposing, dragon-scale shield of thick wyrm chitin, inscribed with gold serpents.

name: Voidling Chitin Shield
description: A surreal shield of jagged voidling chitin, split by star metal cracks that pulse with forbidden energy.

description: A broad bronze shield forged from meteor shards, with swirling green veins and heat fractures.

name: Iron Meteoric Shield
description: A tower shield hammered from dense iron meteorite, crossed by natural fractures and magnetic lines.

name: Silver Meteoric Shield
description: A mirror-bright silver meteoric shield, veined with glowing cracks and moon-phase engravings.

name: Gold Meteoric Shield
description: A resplendent meteor gold shield etched with celestial symbols and crowned with a solar-gem boss.

name: Star Metal Meteoric Shield
description: A deep cosmic blue star metal shield, swirling with living constellations and the timeless energy of the heavens.

name: Tempered Darksteel Shield

name: Warded Darksteel Shield
description: A darksteel wall inscribed with rubin wards, star metal runic circles blazing at its heart.

name: Runed Darksteel Shield
description: A towering slab of runed darksteel with rubin insets and star metal script that writhes across its face.

name: Sigiled Darksteel Shield
description: A grim ceremonial darksteel shield emblazoned with rubin sigils and arcane lines of star metal.

name: Shadowforged Darksteel Shield
description: A black darksteel shield veined with light blue ether, pulsing with an unsettling dark power.

name: Worldforged Darksteel Shield
description: A colossal shield of world-shaped, blood-red darksteel, girded by star metal veins older than memory.
